bibl.title: Marina el-Alamein: newly discovered bath after the 2017 season.
bibl.seg: Krzysztof Jakubiak, Marina el-Alamein: newly discovered bath after the 2017 season.
Polish Archaeology in the Mediterranean. 26/1. Research (Warsaw, 2017) pp. 57-66, figg.
bibl.note: Most of the activity during the 2017 season at the archaeological site of Marina el-Alamein was focused on two areas situated in the northern part of the town: two rooms were cleared of building H.40, originally a large, multi-roomed and most probably prosperous house; structure H.39 was confirmed as a small but richly decorated bath complex with traces of wall painting and geometric mosaic floors.
